title: Croatian Potato Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting dish that combines the flavors of Croatia with the simplicity of a potato casserole.
instructions: Boil the potatoes until they're tender, then dice them.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked potatoes, sausage mixture, and shredded cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
